## File: `web_api.py`

# FastAPI Application: Web API for Development Team Orchestrator

## Overview
The `web_api.py` module defines a FastAPI application that exposes various endpoints for controlling and monitoring a development team orchestrator. The orchestrator manages AI model sessions, discussion sessions, and filesystem operations. This document provides a concise analysis of the API contract and data flow, focusing on routes, models, and business logic.

## Routes and Endpoints

### Control Endpoints
| HTTP Method | Path                | Description                                                                                     |
|-------------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| POST        | `/api/control/pause`| Pause automation for all controllers.                                                           |
| POST        | `/api/control/resume`| Resume automation for all controllers.                                                          |
| POST        | `/api/control/{model_name}/key/{key_name}` | Send a specific key to a controller. |
| POST        | `/api/control/send-prompt` | Send a prompt to one or more AI models. |
| GET         | `/api/control/status`| Get the status of all controllers and the API server.                                           |
| POST        | `/api/control/start-sessions` | Start sessions for specified models. |
| POST        | `/api/control/stop-sessions` | Stop sessions for specified models. |

### Discussion Endpoints
| HTTP Method | Path                          | Description                                                                                     |
|-------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| POST        | `/api/discussion/configure`   | Configure a discussion with participants, max turns, etc.                                      |
| POST        | `/api/discussion/start`       | Start an orchestrated discussion.                                                               |
| POST        | `/api/discussion/extend`      | Extend the turn limit of an ongoing discussion.                                                |
| POST        | `/api/discussion/stop`        | Stop an active discussion.                                                                      |
| POST        | `/api/discussion/human/submit`| Submit a human participant's response to the current turn.                                     |
| POST        | `/api/discussion/human/skip`  | Skip the current human turn without submitting a response.                                     |
| POST        | `/api/discussion/human/bypass/toggle` | Toggle bypassing human turns in the rotation. |
| GET         | `/api/discussion/status`      | Get the current status of the discussion.                                                      |

### Instruction File Endpoints
| HTTP Method | Path                     | Description                                                                                     |
|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| GET         | `/api/instructions/{model_name}` | Fetch the instruction file for a given model. |
| POST        | `/api/instructions/{model_name}` | Save the instruction file for a given model. |

### Model Settings Endpoints
| HTTP Method | Path                          | Description                                                                                     |
|-------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| GET         | `/api/settings/model/{model_name}` | Get the current settings for a model. |
| POST        | `/api/settings/model/{model_name}` | Update the settings for a model. |
| DELETE      | `/api/settings/model/{model_name}` | Reset the settings for a model to defaults. |

### Filesystem Endpoints
| HTTP Method | Path                          | Description                                                                                     |
|-------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| POST        | `/api/fs/browse`              | Browse the filesystem directory. |
| POST        | `/api/fs/prepare-project`     | Prepare a project directory by creating instruction files if they don't exist. |
| POST        | `/api/fs/create-folder`       | Create a new folder in the specified directory. |

### Streaming Endpoints
| HTTP Method | Path                          | Description                                                                                     |
|-------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| GET         | `/ws/session/{model_name}`    | Stream the output of a session over a WebSocket connection. |
| GET         | `/ws/discussion/events`       | Stream real-time discussion events over a WebSocket connection. |

## Models (Pydantic)

### DiscussionConfig
- `max_turns`: `int` (default: 10) - Maximum number of turns in the discussion.
- `starting_model`: `Optional[str]` - The model that starts the discussion.
- `participants`: `Optional[Sequence[str]]` - List of participants in the discussion.
- `discussion_topic`: `Optional[str]` - Topic of the discussion.
- `include_history`: `bool` (default: True) - Whether to include discussion history.
- `log_level`: `Optional[str]` - Log level for the discussion.

### ExtendDiscussionRequest
- `extend_by`: `int` (ge: 1) - Number of additional turns to allow.

### HumanSubmitRequest
- `response`: `str` (required) - Human's response text.

### MacroRequest
- `agent`: `str` (required) - Target agent name.
- `macro_name`: `str` (required) - Macro name defined in config.yaml.

### ModelSettingsUpdate
- `project_directory`: `str` (required) - Absolute project directory path.
- `overrides`: `Dict[str, Any]` (default: {}) - Per-model overrides.

### NewFolder
- `path`: `str` (required) - Path to the directory where the new folder will be created.
- `folderName`: `str` (required) - Name of the new folder.

### PromptRequest
- `prompt`: `str` (required) - The prompt to send to the models.
- `models`: `list[str]` (required) - List of model names to send the prompt to.
- `submit`: `bool` (default: True) - Whether to submit the prompt.

### StartSessionsRequest
- `project_directory`: `str` (required) - Project directory path.
- `models`: `Optional[Sequence[str]]` - List of models to start sessions for.

### StopSessionsRequest
- `models`: `Optional[Sequence[str]]` - List of models to stop sessions for.

### InstructionFile
- `content`: `str` (required) - Content of the instruction file.
- `project_directory`: `Optional[str]` - Project directory path.

### DirectoryPath
- `path`: `str` (required) - Path to the directory.

## Business Logic

### Controller Control
- **Pause/Resume**: Pause or resume automation for all controllers.
- **Send Key**: Send a specific key to a controller.
- **Send Prompt**: Send a prompt to one or more AI models.
- **Start/Stop Sessions**: Start or stop sessions for specified models.

### Discussion Management
- **Configure Discussion**: Set up a discussion with participants, max turns, etc.
- **Start Discussion**: Begin an orchestrated discussion.
- **Extend Discussion**: Extend the turn limit of an ongoing discussion.
- **Stop Discussion**: Stop an active discussion.
- **Submit Human Turn**: Submit a human participant's response to the current turn.
- **Skip Human Turn**: Skip the current human turn without submitting a response.
- **Toggle Bypass Human**: Toggle the bypass_human flag to skip human turns in the rotation.

### Instruction File Management
- **Get Instruction File**: Fetch the instruction file for a given model.
- **Save Instruction File**: Save the instruction file for a given model
